arguments.command:
$tmp="$env:TEMP\hone_wheel_probe"; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
python -m pip wheel . --no-build-isolation --no-deps -w $tmp 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5
Get-ChildItem $tmp
$whl=(Get-ChildItem $tmp\*.whl | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
python -c "import zipfile,sys; z=zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]); print('\n'.join(z.namelist()))" $whl
